symptom: GitHub Actions research-governance Typecheck failed with TS2322 when a synthetic regression assigned a Function/unknown-typed hook directly to overloaded Reflect.apply. The verify job was separate; Post Checkout succeeded. No private data, protected N2, or production behavior was involved.
lesson: A test hook can preserve runtime behavior but still fail TypeScript when directly assigned to an overloaded generic built-in signature; the broad Function/unknown callback does not satisfy every Reflect.apply overload.
guardrail: When writing reversible synthetic hooks for overloaded Reflect.apply, explicitly preserve or cast to typeof Reflect.apply after delegating non-target calls through the captured original; run the repository TypeScript typecheck before treating the regression as CI-ready. Restore the original in finally and test both privacy denials and benign controls. This is a test-authoring guardrail only.
